url_resolution_rules.covers: 1) Covers.url starting with 'covers/' -> /api/v1/media/covers/<manga_id>/<file>; 2) Covers.fileName -> /api/v1/media/covers/<manga_id>/<fileName> (or external https://uploads.mangadex.org/covers/<manga_id>/<fileName>); 3) Fallback PNG at /api/v1/media/fallback/cover.png
url_resolution_rules.chapters: 1) MinIO prefix chapters/<chapter_id>/NNN.jpg; 2) MangaDex at-home API /api/v1/chapter fallback; 3) Fallback PNG /api/v1/media/fallback/page_<n>.png
